prompt: Which team became the first team to claim back-to-back Asian Cup titles?
answer: Qatar became the latest team to claim back-to-back AFC Asian Cup titles, winning in **2019 and 2023**. It was the first such repeat since **Japan’s 2000 and 2004 titles**. Historically, **South Korea** was the first team to win consecutive Asian Cups, in **1956 and 1960**.
